$comment: A resistor_array (10 kohm per channel) with its four channels loaded differently: ch1 into 47 kohm + 1 uF, ch2 into 100 kohm + 0.47 uF, ch3 into 4.7 kohm to ground, ch4 straight across the source. The source steps 5, 2, 8 V over three 100.5 ms phases; taus 57 ms and 110 ms; each channel is an independent RC against the exact exponential.

The edits land at 100.5 ms and 201 ms, inside a classic step and not on a sample, so a stepped classic is judged by the comparison's Richardson rule; the core is within W0 of the closed form at every sample (P0-SG verifier V1).
